name: The Vile Reef
summary: Beneath the Savage Coast, Kin'weelay seeks a shard from the sunken troll city. He hopes to carry Gri'lek's story to Orgrimmar, where the Darkspear can preserve it.

sections.title: Sunken Legends
sections.body:
Northwest of Grom'gol Base Camp, the Savage Coast hides an ancient troll city beneath the water. A violent earthquake shattered the land long ago and sank the city. Now called the Vile Reef, its flooded ruins are home to hostile murlocs who attack anyone who ventures near.

On the sea floor rests a massive stone tablet carved with the story of Gri'lek. He was a legendary troll hero, and the Darkspear still hold his memory sacred.

sections.title: A Keepsake for Orgrimmar
sections.body: The monument is too massive to carry from the depths, so Kin'weelay asks you to break off a shard. He plans to take the fragment to Orgrimmar and enshrine it in a sacred place. There, the Darkspear can keep Gri'lek's strength and honor in their memory.

faq.q: Where is the Vile Reef located?
faq.answer: The Vile Reef lies beneath the Savage Coast, northwest of Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Why does Kin'weelay want the tablet shard?
faq.answer: The tablet preserves the sacred story of Gri'lek, a troll hero. Kin'weelay plans to bring a shard to Orgrimmar and place it in a sacred site, keeping the Darkspear's memory of him alive in their new home.

faq.q: What happened to the ancient city at the Vile Reef?
faq.answer: Long ago, a tremendous earthquake shook the Savage Coast and sank the entire troll city beneath the ocean.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit the Vile Reef now?
faq.answer: Hostile murlocs inhabit the submerged ruins and attack anyone who approaches the sunken city.
Gri'lek is a legendary troll hero whose story was carved on the tablet beneath the Savage Coast. The Darkspear hold his memory sacred.

faq.q: Why take only a shard instead of the whole tablet?
faq.answer: The carved monument on the ocean floor is too massive to carry from the ruins. A single shard can be brought back to Orgrimmar.

angles.text: For the Darkspear, this fragment keeps their ancient traditions and reverence for the great hero Gri'lek alive in their new home in Orgrimmar.
By helping Kin'weelay recover this relic for Orgrimmar, you strengthen the bond of trust between the Horde and the Darkspear tribe.
